rundown: Lightning beat Sabres 8-3 at KeyBank Center in Buffalo, NY in front of 19,070. Lightning led 4-2 after two periods and never looked back. The 3rd period decided it: Lightning won it 4-1.
11 goals in all. Lightning's last: Brandon Hagel Goal Snap Shot, assists: Nikita Kucherov (18), Anthony Cirelli (9), 3rd period 15:06.
Leading the way — Lightning: Nikita Kucherov 3 goals; John Carlson 4 ast, 5 pts. Sabres: Tage Thompson 1 goal; Josh Norris 1 ast; Jason Zucker 1 pts.
Where Lightning won it: they scored 2 on the power play to 1 and out-hit them 33-17.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Lightning closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 3.5; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 11, over by 4.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 11, 6:56 PM ET. It had Lightning 53% and Sabres 47%, projecting Lightning 3.2 – Sabres 3 (6.2 total, Lightning by 0.2).

Final: Lightning 8 – Sabres 3. Right winner: it had Lightning at 53%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Lightning came in with a 7% above average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (11-4-2, 3.7 scored and 3.1 allowed a game over 17 games), worth about 75 and 75 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.2, they scored 8 (+4.8 goals, 152% over); projected to allow 3, they allowed 3 (+0 goals, 0% over).

Sabres came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (8-6-3, 2.9 scored and 3.4 allowed a game over 17 games), worth about 76 and 75 games of evidence. Projected to score 3, they scored 3 (+0 goals, 0% over); projected to allow 3.2, they allowed 8 (+4.8 goals, 152% over).

The bigger miss was Lightning's scoring (+4.8 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 11 against 6.2 projected (+4.8), about the 97th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Lightning by 5 against Lightning by 0.2 projected, about the 3rd percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
BUF ML (+110) at +110: the algo gave it 46% vs 46% fair (+0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 46%). TB ML (-130) at -130: the algo gave it 54% vs 54% fair (-0.2 pts) — won (+0.8u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 54%). BUF +1.5 (-230) at -230: the algo gave it 68% vs 67% fair (+0.6 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. TB -1.5 (+190) at +190: the algo gave it 32% vs 33% fair (-0.6 pts) — won (+1.9u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (-120) at -120: the algo gave it 51% vs 52% fair (-1.2 pts) — won (+0.8u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (+100) at +100: the algo gave it 49% vs 48% fair (+1.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network + DraftKings): spread: 32% of bets on Lightning, 50% of the money — Lightning covered; total: 67% of bets on the over, 82% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 85% of bets on Lightning, 72% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Lightning, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.657 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -4.8 goals. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 48 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.963 and gives home teams +0 goals. Team corrections so far: Lightning attack ×1.040, defense ×0.979 (4 games); Sabres attack ×0.960, defense ×1.039 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 4.8 goals), no bet.
